{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the trial data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check all column names exactly
print("Column names:")
for col in trial_df.columns:
    print(f"- '{col}'")

# Check the actual column name for baseline biomarker
# Use a case-insensitive search
import re

# Look for columns that might contain 'baseline' or 'biomarker'
matching_cols = [col for col in trial_df.columns if re.search('biomarker|baseline', col, re.IGNORECASE)]
print("\nMatching columns:", matching_cols)

# Check the first few values of the matching column
if matching_cols:
    col_name = matching_cols[0]
    print(f"\nFirst 5 values of '{col_name}':")
    print(trial_df[col_name].head())

# Now check the data dictionary
try:
    data_dict = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/data_dictionary.md', sep='|', skiprows=1, names=['Variable', 'Description'], engine='python')
    data_dict = data_dict.dropna(subset=['Variable'])
    data_dict = data_dict.reset_index(drop=True)
    print("\nData dictionary:")
    print(data_dict)
except Exception as e:
    print(f"\nError reading data dictionary: {e}")"}
